import bpy, bmesh, json, time
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Matrix
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
cap=root/'captures/terminal_surface_20261113'
c=bpy.data.collections['Terminal_Craft']; ex=bpy.data.collections['Terminal_Export']
assert c.get('terminal13_pass')
names=['HarborCraft_WorkingTimber','HarborCraft_WeatheredTimber','HarborCraft_T13_ApronTimber','HarborCraft_T13_EntryWood','HarborCraft_T13_PostIron']
# Rebuild only static groups. Dynamic pivots and local geometry are untouched.
old_states=[(col,col.hide_viewport,col.hide_render) for col in [c,ex]]
for col,_,_ in old_states:col.hide_viewport=False;col.hide_render=False
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
deps=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
report={}
for name in names:
 obs=[o for o in c.objects if o.type=='MESH' and o.get('harbor_rig','Static')=='Static' and o.data.materials and o.data.materials[0] and o.data.materials[0].name==name]
 assert obs,name
 copies=[]
 for ob in obs:
  ob.hide_set(False)
  me=bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(ob.evaluated_get(deps),preserve_all_data_layers=True,depsgraph=deps)
  # Resolve evaluated material IDs to persistent originals before saving/exporting.
  mats=[bpy.data.materials[m.name] for m in me.materials if m]
  me.materials.clear()
  for mat in mats:me.materials.append(mat)
  if len(me.uv_layers)==1:me.uv_layers[0].name='HarborSurfaceUV'
  bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(me)
  bmesh.ops.triangulate(bm,faces=list(bm.faces))
  bm.to_mesh(me);bm.free();me.update()
  me.transform(ob.matrix_world);me.update()
  cp=bpy.data.objects.new('T13_export_copy',me);ex.objects.link(cp)
  copies.append(cp)
 bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
 for ob in copies:ob.select_set(True)
 bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=copies[0]
 bpy.ops.object.join()
 merged=bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active
 node='TerminalMesh_'+name
 old=ex.objects.get(node)
 if old:
  old.data=merged.data;bpy.data.objects.remove(merged,do_unlink=True);merged=old
 else:merged.name=node
 assert merged.matrix_world==Matrix.Identity(4),node
 if name.startswith('HarborCraft_T13_') and name!='HarborCraft_T13_PostIron':
  assert merged.data.color_attributes.get('T13WearTint')
  ca=merged.data.color_attributes
  ca.active_color_index=ca.find('T13WearTint');ca.render_color_index=ca.find('T13WearTint')
 report[name]={'sources':len(obs),'vertices':len(merged.data.vertices),'triangles':len(merged.data.polygons),'colors':[x.name for x in merged.data.color_attributes]}
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for ob in ex.objects:ob.hide_set(False);ob.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=next(o for o in ex.objects if o.type=='MESH')
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(root/'assets/coast/harbor_terminal.glb'),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True,export_materials='EXPORT',export_texcoords=True,export_normals=True,export_tangents=True,export_vertex_color='ACTIVE',export_yup=True,export_cameras=False,export_lights=False,export_apply=True)
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for col,v,r in old_states:col.hide_viewport=v;col.hide_render=r
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
(cap/'export_pass.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('TERMINAL_STATIC_EXPORT_OK',report)
